name: 00_spawn
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; window.__GP = JSON.stringify(gp.debugState()); gp.qa.lamp(true, 1);

name: 10_hands_lamp
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; gp.qa.lamp(true, 1); g.look(g.player.position.x, 0, g.player.position.z, g.player.yaw, -0.16);

name: 11_hands_carry_core
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; gp.inventory.add('fuse_core', 1); g.look(g.player.position.x, 0, g.player.position.z, g.player.yaw, -0.22);

name: 12_hands_reach
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; gp.inventory.take('fuse_core', 1); gp.hands.setReaching(true, true); g.look(g.player.position.x, 0, g.player.position.z, g.player.yaw, -0.16);

name: 13_lamp_dying_in_dark
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; gp.hands.setReaching(false); gp.qa.circuits(false); gp.qa.lamp(true, 0.10); g.look(g.player.position.x, 0, g.player.position.z, g.player.yaw, -0.05);

name: 14_lamp_healthy_in_dark
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; gp.qa.lamp(true, 1.0); g.look(g.player.position.x, 0, g.player.position.z, g.player.yaw, -0.05);

name: 15_lamp_covered
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; gp.flashlight.setCover(1); for (let i=0;i<40;i++) gp.flashlight.update(1/60, null); g.look(g.player.position.x, 0, g.player.position.z, g.player.yaw, -0.05);

name: 20_surveyor_lit_full
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp || !gp.surveyor) return; gp.flashlight.setCover(0); gp.qa.circuits(true); gp.qa.lamp(false); const p = g.player.position, y = g.player.yaw; const fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); gp.qa.surveyorTo(p.x + fx * 6.5, p.z + fz * 6.5, y + Math.PI); gp.qa.pose(0.9, 0.4); g.look(p.x, 0, p.z, y, 0.10);

name: 21_surveyor_scale_vs_player
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp || !gp.surveyor) return; const p = g.player.position, y = g.player.yaw; const fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); gp.qa.surveyorTo(p.x + fx * 3.4, p.z + fz * 3.4, y + Math.PI); gp.qa.pose(0.0, 0.0); g.look(p.x, 0, p.z, y, 0.22);

name: 22_surveyor_frozen_midstride
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp || !gp.surveyor) return; const p = g.player.position, y = g.player.yaw; const fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); gp.qa.surveyorTo(p.x + fx * 5.5, p.z + fz * 5.5, y + Math.PI + 0.45); gp.qa.pose(1.55, 0.78); g.look(p.x, 0, p.z, y, 0.12);

name: 23_surveyor_measuring
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp || !gp.surveyor) return; const p = g.player.position, y = g.player.yaw; const fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); const rx = Math.cos(y), rz = -Math.sin(y); gp.qa.surveyorTo(p.x + fx * 5.0 + rx * 1.4, p.z + fz * 5.0 + rz * 1.4, y + Math.PI - 0.9); gp.qa.measure(8); g.look(p.x, 0, p.z, y, 0.14);

name: 24_surveyor_head_plate
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp || !gp.surveyor) return; const p = g.player.position, y = g.player.yaw; const fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); gp.qa.surveyorTo(p.x + fx * 2.4, p.z + fz * 2.4, y + Math.PI); gp.qa.pose(0.4, -0.5); g.look(p.x, 0, p.z, y, 0.46);

name: 25_surveyor_lamp_only
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp || !gp.surveyor) return; gp.qa.circuits(false); gp.qa.lamp(true, 1.0); const p = g.player.position, y = g.player.yaw; const fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); gp.qa.surveyorTo(p.x + fx * 5.0, p.z + fz * 5.0, y + Math.PI); gp.qa.pose(0.9, 0.25); g.look(p.x, 0, p.z, y, 0.12);

name: 26_surveyor_capture
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp || !gp.surveyor) return; gp.qa.circuits(true); gp.qa.lamp(false); const p = g.player.position, y = g.player.yaw; const fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); gp.qa.surveyorTo(p.x + fx * 1.15, p.z + fz * 1.15, y + Math.PI); const s = gp.surveyor; s.captureBlend = 1; s.state = 'CAPTURING'; gp.qa.pose(0.2, 0.0); g.look(p.x, 0, p.z, y, 0.36);

name: 27_surveyor_far_down_a_run
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp || !gp.surveyor) return; const p = g.player.position, y = g.player.yaw; const fx = -Math.sin(y), fz = -Math.cos(y); gp.qa.surveyorTo(p.x + fx * 16, p.z + fz * 16, y + Math.PI); gp.qa.pose(2.2, 0.2); g.look(p.x, 0, p.z, y, 0.02);

name: 30_props_in_world
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; gp.surveyor && gp.surveyor.despawn(); const props = gp.interactables.props.filter(p => p.root); window.__PROPS = JSON.stringify(props.map(p => p.id)); if (!props.length) return; const r = props[0].root; const pos = r.position; const yaw = Math.atan2(-(pos.x - (pos.x - 2.4)), -(pos.z - (pos.z - 2.4))); g.look(pos.x, 0, pos.z + 2.6, Math.PI, -0.06);

name: 31_debug_dump
setup: const gp = g.gameplay; if (!gp) return; window.__GP_FINAL = JSON.stringify(gp.debugState());
